# CREDIT. This table is taken from libfilmshell (OpenSpartan, https://github.com/OpenSpartan/libfilmshell,
# MIT licence, copyright (c) 2026 OpenSpartan; licence text in LICENSE-libfilmshell next to this file), file
# `src/game/medals_data.rs`, last commit on that file 291f85e ("Generated from the game's files" in that file's
# own header). The maintainers of libfilmshell derived the medal list from the game's files; this module did not
# WHAT IS TAKEN. For each of the 157 medals of that file: the game's medal index (the discriminant of its
# `Medal` enum, the byte 59 of a highlight event), the sorting weight (the fourth element of its `row()`, "the
# value `HighlightEvents` records carry", the byte 47 of a highlight event) and its English name (`name()`). The
# medal's kind, its difficulty and its personal score are not kept.
# WHAT IS TRANSFORMED. One tab-separated line per medal, in the order of the sorting weight then of the index.
# The table is regenerated from libfilmshell, not edited by hand.
# HOW IT IS CHECKED. All 124 pairs measured on the maintainer's own films (44,568 medal events, see
# `testdata/corpus_medailles_2026-09-02.tsv`) are in this table with the same weight, the same index and the same
# name. The weights equal the `sortingWeight` of the 151 medals that the official Waypoint medal catalogue lists.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated): sorting weight (decimal), medal index (decimal), English name.
